earth.text: NASA replaced ISS CO2 units with nine non-toxic fine-water-mist extinguishers (2015–2016) whose zero-leak valve spun off to >450 industrial/military trailers, while NFPA 99 notes hyperbaric water suppression follows distinct criteria.

NFPA 99 defines sea-level oxygen-enriched atmospheres above 23.5% O2, and 1923–1996 hyperbaric reviews counted 77 deaths in 35 chamber fires above 28% O2, underscoring oxygen limits even though Earth buoyancy prevents direct 0 g extrapolation.

Local context in Vietnam includes medical oxygen system inspections in Ho Chi Minh City treatment facilities and the 2023 Khương Hạ apartment fire in Hanoi (56 deaths), illustrating enclosed-space smoke and oxygen hazards.
